CRLR No.880 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. V.P. Bahuguna, Advocate for the revisionist.
2. Mr. S.C. Dumka, AGA with Ms. Sweta Dobhal, Brief 
Holder for the State.
3. Mr. Sushil Kumar, Advocate holding brief of Mr. Nalin 
Saun, Advocate for respondent no.2. 
4. Notices were issued to respondent no.2 on Delay 
Condonation Application No.1 of 2024 by the Coordinate 
Bench of this Court on 10.12.2024 as the revision was 
barred by limitation.
5. Today, learned counsel appears for respondent no.2 
and the delay is not seriously opposed by him. 
6. This Court finds sufficient reasons in the affidavit 
filed in support of the Delay Condonation Application. 
Accordingly, the delay is condoned and the Delay 
Condonation Application (IA No.1 of 2024) is allowed.
7. List this revision on 23.09.2025 for admission.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 04.07.2025
Ravi
